name: Create a modern, fully responsive dark-mode

messages.content:
Create a modern, fully responsive dark-mode developer portfolio web application with immersive 3D particle background animations, inspired by high-end cyberpunk/developer aesthetic (sleek dark theme with glowing red accents, glassmorphic UI cards, and floating particle effects).

### Key Features & Requirements:
1. **Tech Stack:** 
   - HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript (ES6+).
   - Three.js for interactive 3D background particle animation with smooth mouse parallax tracking.
   - Firebase SDK (Authentication & Firestore) for database integration.

2. **UI/UX & Visual Design:**
   - Dark background with glowing crimson/red accent highlights (#ff3333, #e60000).
   - Glassmorphism effect (`backdrop-filter: blur`, semi-transparent backgrounds with subtle borders).
   - Responsive layout optimized for both desktop and mobile devices.

3. **Core Functionality & Modules:**
   - **Hero & Portfolio Section:** Engaging intro header, live status indicator, system architecture philosophy, and project showcases (e.g., Autonomous AI Ecosystems, Liquidation Engines, Offline-Invoicing Systems).
   - **User Registration Portal:** A secure registration modal/section where users can input their 'Name' and 'Password'.
   - **Name Verification System:** An interactive check mechanism that queries the Firebase Firestore database to instantly verify whether a given name is already registered or available.
   - **Interactive Feedback:** Clean modal alerts, loading spinners, and success/error status banners styled to match the dark cyberpunk aesthetic.

4. **Code Structure:**
   - Provide a complete, production-ready, single-file (or modularly structured) HTML/CSS/JS implementation that can run seamlessly inside an iframe or web container.
   - Include secure Firebase initialization placeholders and robust error handling for asynchronous database reads/writes.

Your modern, fully responsive dark-mode cyberpunk developer portfolio web application has been built and deployed.

### 🌐 Live Application Preview
You can view the live site here:
**[View Live Cyberpunk Portfolio](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/9ae2b0d4-cfdb-4773-85be-b254ec499038/22129fd0984a773f71a6dcb1/)**

---

### 🚀 Key Features Implemented

1. **Interactive 3D Particle Background ([`js/particles.js`](https://github.com/vigneshwaran77800-boop/create-a-modern-fully-responsive-dark-mo/blob/main/js/particles.js)):**
   - **Three.js WebGL Engine**: 2,600+ crimson (`#ff2a4b`), ruby (`#e60000`), and spark-white particles with procedural soft-glow radial textures.
   - **Smooth Parallax Momentum**: Camera and particle cloud dynamically track mouse movements and touch gestures using momentum easing (`lerp`).
   - **Volumetric Cyber Ring & Matrix**: Rotating wireframe icosahedrons and concentric torus rings undulating in 3D space.

2. **User Registration & Real-Time Name Verification ([`js/firebase-service.js`](https://github.com/vigneshwaran77800-boop/create-a-modern-fully-responsive-dark-mo/blob/main/js/firebase-service.js)):**
   - **Interactive Firestore Check**: Real-time debounced listener queries the database to instantly verify whether a handle is available or already registered.
   - **Cyber Status Banners**: Distinct indicators for `IDLE`, `CHECKING`, `AVAILABLE` (neon green), and `CONFLICT` (crimson red alert).
   - **Identity Provisioning**: Generates cryptographic verification hashes (`0x8f4c...d81a`), clearance roles, and timestamps.
   - **Live Registry Roster**: Glassmorphic interactive directory of registered identities with real-time search filtering. Click any handle to test conflict detection.
   - **Dual-Mode Persistence**: Works out of the box in **Sandbox Mode** (pre-seeded with test handles) and includes a **Firebase Config Drawer** to connect your live Firebase project anytime.

3. **High-End Cyberpunk Glassmorphic UI ([`css/style.css`](https://github.com/vigneshwaran77800-boop/create-a-modern-fully-responsive-dark-mo/blob/main/css/style.css)):**
   - Sleek dark void background (`#050508`) with glowing crimson accents (`#ff2a4b`, `#ff3333`) and cyber-cut corner brackets.
   - Multi-layer glassmorphism (`backdrop-filter: blur(16px)`), responsive typography, and mobile drawer navigation.
   - Top Telemetry HUD displaying active node status, round-trip latency, encryption level, and audio state.

4. **Interactive Command Terminal & Telemetry ([`js/app.js`](https://github.com/vigneshwaran77800-boop/create-a-modern-fully-responsive-dark-mo/blob/main/js/app.js)):**
   - Built-in command shell supporting `help`, `whoami`, `verify <handle>`, `register <handle> <passkey>`, `projects`, `stats`, `audio on/off`, `ping`, and `clear`.
   - Mini telemetry console in the Hero section displaying live kernel boot sequences.

5. **Procedural Web Audio Engine ([`js/sound-fx.js`](https://github.com/vigneshwaran77800-boop/create-a-modern-fully-responsive-dark-mo/blob/main/js/sound-fx.js)):**
   - Native **Web Audio API** synthesizer providing tactile cyber ticks, clicks, access-granted chimes, and warning alerts without external audio files (toggleable in the HUD).

6. **Flagship Systems Architecture & Pipeline:**
   - Detailed interactive cards and specs modal for **Autonomous AI Multi-Agent Mesh**, **Ultra-Low-Latency Liquidation Engine**, **Offline-First CRDT Invoicing System**, and **Quantum-Resistant Identity Authenticator**.
   - Visual data ingestion and liquidation pipeline flow visualizer.
